text_simplified: Sound creed is the firm root from which noble manners and righteous deeds grow. For this reason, Luqman the Wise began his counsel to his son by establishing monotheism and forbidding polytheism, because it is the greatest injustice—it equates the deficient created being with the Perfect Creator, glorified is He. He then instilled in him faith in Allah's all-encompassing knowledge of everything.
